title: fastProjectAI crashes every time I click on a fastProjectAI tab
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
Overview of the Problem

In a few of instances, we’ve found after installing fastProjectAI, fastProjectAI crashes every time you click on any of the fastProjectAI tabs in the ribbon. The problem is due to an update in Microsoft Project that was released in the June 2020.

Solution

The solution is to update your Microsoft Project. At a minimum, it should be later than the above update.
